title: feat(ridk3): ridge-slide same-k holds at k=3: t=9 vs t=13
science: rho3 at k=3 on B_12: t=9 vs 13, 243>169. Reports on the same run t(1,0,0)=3, t(1,1,1)=5, t(2,0,0)=6, t(2,2,2)=10 -- so this single PR carries the low-k corner of the whole rho3 table and shows the axis law is 3k (not k+12) below the k=6 crossover.
